commits.message: added Rmd reports for two more models. Lambda free and no forgetting

reworked to implement 2 stage fitting process: first accuracy curves are fit with sum of squared error. These best fitting params are then used as starting parameters, along with timing parameters, to fit the estimated joint RT and Acc distributions
added an RTrounded column
changed the starting parameters and low and behold, no more consistent overestimating of the 2 cue performance

bug fixes in model code. fixed indexing into preds and obs vector in group model to be the same positions. fixed check on paramater values to allow for NAs which definitely do occur when time parameters are not specified. Remove practice test accuracy from the values being fit since they are already really included in the joint probabilities

patched plotPCL to only use the RTs of output items when finding the medians for plotting, and to no longer calculate the average parameters and append it to the results list because it breaks reusing the model object inplotPCL

instead of appending the aggregated results to the results list in the model object, just calculate them at display time. Moving this calculation to the chunks file allows for smoother dplyr chaining, and allows the model object to be fed through plotPCL multiple times. Otherwise, with the appended results, the second plotting attempt fails because the appended result is not of class optimx, nor should it be, and thus has no coef method defined which breaks the function

added some debug level support, idea is to get around optimx annoyingly wrapping any errors encountered evaluating the objective function in some unhelpfuf 'cant evaluate function at starting parameters message'. debug level 1 will just evaluate the objective function and return the data frames with the observed and predicted results. note that the output stored in the model results list is not useable by the plotPCL function at the time of writing this commit message, may be added later. level 2 requires a vector with 2 elements, first is level and second is line in the PCL file where you want a break point set. untested though
